注 意 事 项

entries.Original: No guide entry for this fight.
entries.Translated: 这场战斗没有引导条目。

entries.Original: An older GluttonyCombo that also fills familiars is loaded. LazyCrucible is not writing until it is updated.
entries.Translated: 加载了一个也能填满家庭成员的较旧的GluttonyCombo。LazyCrucible在更新之前不会写入。

entries.Original: AutoDuty is running this board and picks its own familiars; LazyCrucible is leaving the familiar screens alone.
entries.Translated: AutoDuty正在运行此板并选择自己的家庭； LazyCrucible正在独自离开熟悉的屏幕。

entries.Original: AutoDuty reports running but has stopped stepping (
entries.Translated: AutoDuty报告正在运行，但已停止步进（

entries.Original: ); LazyCrucible is not standing down for it.
No familiar selection yet this session.
entries.Translated: 本课还没有熟悉的选择。

entries.Original: Fill the run roster at the Bentbranch Meadows entry menu
entries.Translated: 在Bentbranch Meadows条目菜单中填写运行名册

entries.Original: Once per visit to the entry menu, sets the ten familiars that cover the board's battles best. A roster changed by hand is left alone until the next run.
entries.Translated: 每次访问条目菜单一次，设置最能覆盖董事会战斗的十个家族。手动更改的名册将被单独留下，直到下一次运行。

entries.Original: Fill the Battlehorn slots before each fight
entries.Translated: 在每场战斗前填满战斗号角位置

entries.Original: On the formation screen before every fight, puts the three familiars that answer that fight's mechanics on the horns: elemental weakness, interrupts (Soul Crush), dispels (Quelling Wave), cleanses and crowd control the enemies are vulnerable to. Knocked-out familiars are never picked; badly hurt ones lose to a healthy one that fits nearly as well. Never starts the fight, never touches the shop's feeding screen, and stops for that screen as soon as a slot is changed by hand.
entries.Translated: 在每场战斗前的阵法屏幕上，将三名家族成员放在角上，他们回答了战斗的机制：元素弱点、中断（灵魂粉碎）、驱散（平息波浪）、净化和人群控制敌人容易受到影响。被淘汰的家庭永远不会被选中；严重受伤的家庭失去了一个几乎适合的健康的家庭。切勿开始战斗，切勿触摸商店的喂食屏幕，并在手动更换插槽时立即停止该屏幕。

entries.Original: Selection screens (only when you open them; never walks, starts a battle, rests, sells or leaves)
entries.Translated: 选择屏幕（仅当您打开它们时；从不走路、开始战斗、休息、出售或离开）

entries.Original: Beast Feed: pick who eats the feed and confirm
entries.Translated: 野兽饲料：选择谁吃饲料并确认

entries.Original: When a feed is bought, feeds it to the familiar it helps most in the fights ahead. Never a familiar whose kin cannot eat it, one that is full or knocked out, or one that already ate it. A feed that would hurt every familiar (for example max HP -80%) is left to you.
entries.Translated: 当饲料被购买时，将其喂给熟悉的人，它在未来的战斗中最有帮助。从来没有一个熟悉的人，谁的亲戚不能吃它，一个饱了或被淘汰的人，或者一个已经吃了它的人。会伤害每个熟悉的饲料（例如，最大生命值-80 ％ ）留给您。

entries.Original: Shop: buy what the fights ahead call for
entries.Translated: 商店：购买未来战斗所需要的东西

entries.Original: Keeps enough heals for the fights ahead, then buys what keeps you and your familiars alive: resistance to what those fights inflict, max HP and damage-taken gear, revives, and feed for the familiars the horns will use. Each purchase is confirmed only when the prompt names that item. Never sells and never leaves the shop; buying anything yourself hands the rest of the visit to you.
entries.Translated: 为未来的战斗保留足够的治疗，然后购买让你和你的家人活着的东西：对那些战斗造成的抵抗，最大生命值和受到伤害的装备，复活，并为角将使用的家人喂食。只有当提示命名该项目时，才会确认每次购买。从不出售，从不离开商店；您自己购买任何东西，剩下的时间都交给您。

entries.Original: Spoils: Take all when everything fits
entries.Translated: 战利品：在一切都合适的时候拿走一切

entries.Original: If the loot would not fit (or repeats gear you own), shows the best items first and leaves the choice to you.
entries.Translated: 如果战利品不合适（或重复您拥有的装备） ，首先显示最佳物品，然后由您选择。

entries.Original: Marks the choice that helps most and says why. It does not click yet: which button belongs to which choice has not been recorded.
entries.Translated: 标记最有帮助的选择，并说明原因。它还没有点击：哪个按钮属于哪个选择没有被记录。

entries.Original: Campsite: select who rests (you press Rest)
entries.Translated: 露营地：选择谁休息（按休息）

entries.Original: Weighs your heal against the familiars' (resting familiars lose their feed unless they ate Lily Simular) and selects the familiars worth resting. Your self heal wins when you are low. Rest is always your button.
entries.Translated: 权衡您对家族成员的治疗（除非他们吃了Lily Simular ，否则休息的家族成员会失去饲料） ，并选择值得休息的家族成员。当你情绪低落时，你的自我治疗会获胜。休息始终是您的理想选择。

entries.Original: Open the fight guide on the upcoming fight
entries.Translated: 打开即将到来的战斗的战斗指南

entries.Original: When the board layout or the Battlehorn screen points at a fight, the guide opens on it: horn picks and why, what the fight calls for, dangerous hits, mechanics and what to bring.
entries.Translated: 当棋盘布局或Battlehorn屏幕指向战斗时，指南会打开：喇叭拾音和原因，战斗要求什么，危险命中，机制以及携带什么。

entries.Original: Stand down while AutoDuty is running

AutoDuty can run whole Crucible boards and fills the roster and horns with its own team (for example a leveling team). While it is running, LazyCrucible does not touch any Crucible screen, so the two never overwrite each other.
entries.Translated: AutoDuty可以运行整个坩埚板，并用自己的团队（例如调平团队）填充名册和喇叭。在运行期间， LazyCrucible不会触摸任何坩埚屏幕，因此两者永远不会相互覆盖。

entries.Original: One chat line per fight naming each familiar and why it was picked.
entries.Translated: 每场比赛有一条聊天线，为每个熟悉的人命名，以及为什么选择它。

entries.Original: Record Crucible screens to the log
entries.Translated: 将坩埚屏幕记录到日志中

entries.Original: Read-only. Writes every Crucible screen (path choice, spoils, treasure, shop, feeding, campsite, beast gear) and the buttons pressed on it to the Dalamud log, so those screens can be automated later. Never presses anything.
entries.Translated: 只读。将每个坩埚屏幕（路径选择、战利品、宝藏、商店、喂食、营地、野兽装备）及其上按下的按钮写入达拉穆德日志，以便这些屏幕可以稍后自动化。切勿按压任何东西。

entries.Original: still navigating after leaving its run
entries.Translated: 离开其运行后仍在导航

entries.Original: The captured familiar list has not arrived yet (open the Master's Bestiary once); picks assume every familiar is captured.
entries.Translated: 捕获的熟悉列表尚未到达（打开主人的动物园一次） ；选择假设每个熟悉的都被捕获。

entries.Original: Roster (familiars in the most battles' picks, number of battles):
entries.Translated: 名册（大多数战役中的家族，战役次数） ：

entries.Translated: 不写作：加载了一个也填满家庭成员的较旧的GluttonyCombo。
只是没有在冠军榜上留下他们的名字

entries.Translated: 打开LazyCrucible。/lazycrucible指南打开战斗指南；/lazycrucible更新日志显示新内容；/lazycrucible报告将<what happened>问题报告写入插件日志。

entries.Original: also fills Crucible familiars. LazyCrucible will not change familiars until GluttonyCombo is updated.
entries.Translated: 也填满了坩埚家族。在GluttonyCombo更新之前， LazyCrucible不会更改家庭成员。

entries.Translated: [LazyCrucible]问题报告在此会话中不可用：错误报告未启动（原因在插件日志中）。

entries.Original: a familiar holding enmity does not stop it
entries.Translated: 熟悉的抱怨并不能阻止它

entries.Original: not a horn pick for the fights ahead
entries.Translated: 不是未来战斗的喇叭镐

the screen did not change as expected
. The rest of this screen is yours.
Nothing here helps the fights ahead (or your slots are full); leaving the choice to you.
entries.Translated: 这里没有任何东西可以帮助未来的战斗（或者你的插槽已满） ；选择权留给你。
